pushA:shoulder-press.coach: Stay at 15 kg: 7 reps is inside 6 to 10, so aim for 8 on every set.

pushA:incline-db-press.coach: Stay at 10 kg: 7 reps is just under 8, so get 8 on every set first.

pushA:cable-lateral.coach: Lighter: 5 to 7 reps at 10 kg is far under 12. Use 5 kg on another cable station, left arm first.

pushA:chest-fly.coach: Up one step: both sets reached 15 at 25 kg.

pushA:triceps-pushdown.coach: Up one step: every set reached 15 at 20 kg.

pushA:db-lateral.coach: Lighter: 9 reps at 5 kg is far under 15, so use 3 kg.

pullA:pull-up.coach: Every set reached 10: do all sets at 30 kg, and go to 35 kg once 30 kg gives 10 every set.

pullA:cable-row.coach: Stay at 20 kg: 10 reps is in range, so aim for 12 on every set.

pullA:straight-arm-pulldown.coach: Stay at 20 kg: 12 is the bottom of the range, so aim for 13.

pullA:reverse-fly.coach: Lighter: 6 reps is far under 12, so use 5 kg. Switch to face pulls if it hurts.

pullA:cable-lateral.coach: Lighter: 5 to 6 reps at 10 kg is far under 12. Use 5 kg on another cable station, left arm first.

pullA:curl.coach: Stay at 5 kg: sets fell to 7, 6 and 4, so rest longer and get 8 on every set.

legsA:leg-press.coach: First time: pick a weight you could press about 13 times and stop at 10.

legsA:rdl.coach: First time: start with the empty bar or small plates, 8 slow reps with a flat back.

legsA:leg-curl.coach: First time: pick a weight you could curl about 15 times and stop at 12.

legsA:leg-extension.coach: First time: very light and slow. Stop if the spot below the left kneecap hurts.

legsA:standing-calf.coach: First time: pick a weight for 12 slow reps with a full stretch at the bottom.

legsA:cable-crunch.coach: First time: pick a light cable weight for 12 reps, curling the ribs toward the hips.
